description: Reads the app's random draws (card packs, loot boxes): "info" { draw } the chance of each card, the cost and the free openings; "opens" the log of openings, newest first: who, what was paid and the cards dealt. Read-only: draws are set in neblla_update_app_games; to give packs, neblla_credits. More: neblla_get_llms tools/draws

action.description: What to read. By action: info {draw}; opens {user?, draw?, limit?}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

name: neblla_draws
title: Read draws and openings
